# A smoke puff: a faceted ball 0.7 m across, sunset-lit. Origin at its centre.
new
material new Smoke --base-color 1.0000 0.8314 0.6392 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Puff --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.35 --location 0 0 0
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 4
mode object
material assign Smoke
shade flat
export smoke.glb
